non_matches.reason: The state requires subannual positive equity-return autocorrelation followed by three-to-eight-year negative autocorrelation; the packet supplies freight and capacity conditions but no equity-return serial-correlation behavior.
The state requires futures-return moments and HMM probabilities distinguishing bull, bear, and high-variance regimes; the packet provides no return, variance, or state-probability measurements.

The state concerns cross-market correlation inflation caused by elevated source-country variance; the packet contains no cross-market correlations, source-country variance change, or heteroscedasticity correction evidence.

The state requires temporary divergence and subsequent convergence of co-moving equity-pair spreads; the packet reports shipping-system strain without any paired equity spreads or convergence behavior.
The state requires time-series momentum behavior across futures returns and look-back horizons; persistent shipping strain does not evidence futures-return trends or momentum performance.
The state requires fat-tailed and negatively skewed equity returns generated by a Gaussian regime mixture; the packet supplies no return distribution or mixture-model evidence.

The state requires a dominant common factor across banks, brokers, insurers, and hedge funds; the packet contains no financial-sector returns, principal-component share, or institutional loading evidence.

The state requires aggregate NYSE illiquidity to predict future returns and unexpected illiquidity to depress contemporaneous prices; physical shipping scarcity does not supply either traded-market behavior.
The state requires international-equity means, volatilities, and filtered normal-versus-bear regime probabilities; none of those observables appears in the shipping packet.
The state requires joint left-tail asset co-movement to exceed joint right-tail co-movement under a regime-switching model; the packet supplies no multi-asset tail correlations.
The state requires positive weekly equity-return autocorrelation and elevated variance ratios, especially among small-cap portfolios; the packet includes no weekly return or variance-ratio evidence.
The state requires a stock illiquidity premium concentrated in January; the absence of Golden Week shipping relief neither measures that premium nor verifies the January activation condition.
The state requires persistent NYSE-level ILLIQ with a near-unit-root monthly process; persistent logistics congestion is not evidence of the named traded-market illiquidity measure.

The state requires clustered return shocks, significant squared-return autocorrelation, or large GARCH persistence parameters; the packet reports operational persistence without financial-return volatility behavior.

The state requires elevated international-equity correlation together with a high filtered bear-regime probability; the packet contains neither correlation measurements nor a bear-regime activation signal.

as_of.observation_horizon: current conditions through next-year contract talks
